answer: The raven schedule is applied in dawn and relic publishes each instalment. A payout is split so that 43% arrives at settlement and the rest over 11 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. Anyone therefore cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 893 identities would post 4201 proofs and burn roughly 87 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
